meta.name: Dataiku Resource Usage Monitoring
meta.description: Monitor the usage of your platform to understand resource intensity of projects & users. Quickly take action and refine your infrastructure strategy.
meta.long_description:
In order to scale and provide a reliable service, platform administrators need to understand how resources are used and to what end.  This capacity planning is a critical part of systems administration, as it ensures that a system can handle future workloads without running into performance issues. 
Thanks to this solution, Dataiku platform administrators have a simplified overview of the computation across all used infrastructures (whether it is local, SQL or Kubernetes). This analytics approach to resource monitoring eases engagement of all Analytics teams in a collective approach towards improved efficiency.
